items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: All 5 deferred items from PR #699 review addressed; no extra scope added.

items.note: Existing exit-1/ValueError contract preserved; no new I/O boundary introduced.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: New tests assert on file content / exit code / stderr text, not internals; each covers a real happy or regression path.

items.note: No file exceeds 300 LOC (write_context_term.py sits exactly at the cap); renamed tests now match actual behavior.
